intent: Show a measurement within a known range, such as storage used or a password's strength

properties.description: Visible label at the start of the text row; names the meter (aria-labelledby). Authored label part text seeds it.

Intl.NumberFormat options for the value text (Base UI format): an object as a property, JSON in the attribute, e.g. {"style":"unit","unit":"gigabyte"}. Without it: the ratio as a whole percentage. Formatted by formatNumber (U+2212 minus, narrow spaces before units).
BCP 47 locale for the value text; empty: the runtime's.
aria-valuetext instead of the formatted value (the visible value is unchanged).

content.children: Optional authored [data-part] label, value, track and track › indicator, adopted onto the generated parts.

constraints: The value is clamped to [min, max]; the fill is (value − min) / (max − min) of the track, carried by --ui-ratio.
The value text is formatNumber(value, format) with format, else the ratio as a whole percentage; aria-valuetext is the same text unless value-text sets another.
The label names the meter (aria-labelledby); without a label give it an aria-label.
A meter is static: it has no keyboard behavior and no form value. Task completion is a progress bar.

avoidWhen.when: Showing how much of a task is done, or that work is ongoing.
avoidWhen.reason: That is progress (role=progressbar, indeterminate without a value), not a measurement.

nodes.summary: The visible label (Base UI Meter.Label) at the start of the text row; names the meter. Hidden when empty.
The formatted value (Base UI Meter.Value) at the end of the text row, tabular figures; aria-hidden, the root's aria-valuetext says it.
